title: blessed/release-candidate-plan/v1
description: The EXPLICIT producer-generated plan that scripts/release/build-candidate.sh consumes. The producer states identity, signing intent, public-notes filename, and each artifact's id/filename/platform/install_kind (and optional sbom) — with NO sizes or hashes and NO filename inference. The shared tool verifies every referenced file exists, computes size + SHA-256, builds SHA256SUMS + provenance + the closed `files` set, and emits release-candidate.json.

safeBasename.description: Basename only — no path separators, no traversal, no leading dot.

version.description: Anchored MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-PRERELEASE]; no build metadata (matches release-candidate/v1).

created_at.description: Caller-supplied RFC3339 timestamp — the tool never reads the clock, so a rerun is byte-identical.

signature_profile.description: Optional runtime-native artifact signature profile carried into the candidate (releases.candidate@1). v1 recognizes the Tauri native updater adapter only. Must be declared with signature_key_id and a per-artifact signature sidecar.

signature_key_id.description: Optional runtime-native artifact key id carried into the candidate. Must be declared with signature_profile.
